The '''Repulsorlift Drive Adaptor''' was manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and was part of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. It gave the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] capability similar to the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. The Adaptor was driven by the fighter's [[Turbo generator]].<ref name="SWS" />
